text:
Maya: FYI invoice preview for tenant `beta-inc` had ~1.8x token bump after the routing-policy feature flip at 15:42 UTC. link: https://dash.internal/redwood/invoices/preview/BETA-INC :eyes:
Theo: saw that. looking at raw events -> many with route_hint="" and route_id set to "fallback-v1". suspect policy mismatch between router and resolver.
Sofia: did we change the default fallback bucket in the new policy? that could move lots of low-cardinality traffic into billed buckets.
Maya: yes, policy change introduced `preferred_fallback=legacy` to improve latency for cold models.
Theo: problem: edge adds `X-Route` header but resolver now emits `X-Route-Id`. older proxies rely on `X-Route`. when missing, edge retries once, causing duplicate events.
Sofia: can we detect duplicates by request_id? any idempotency key present?
Maya: yes request_id exists in events. aggregator dedupe window is 2s; retries occur ~3s apart due to backoff hence missed.
Theo: short-term: increase dedupe window to 10s for billing pipeline only. It's toggleable in config.
ben-ingest-bot: config change proposed: billing.dedupe_window_seconds=10; review by Theo.
Sofia: long-term: standardize header `X-Route-Canonical` and make the proxy tolerant to both `X-Route`/`X-Route-Id`. also add route_resolution_version to events.
Maya: agree. create proto opt-in field `route_res_v` and fallback_reason enum. keep consumer-safe path.
Theo: I'll open PR for dedupe window and proxy header parsing. aim for canary rollout 20% in 30m.
qa-bot: canary checklist: smoke tests, invoice-preview regression <1%, consumer-deserialization pass.
Sofia: also add console telemetry card that flags sudden shifts in route distribution per-tenant with threshold 2x baseline.
Maya: adding owners: Theo (ingest), Sofia (console), QA (recon). ticket MET-3421.
Theo: patch merged, rolling to canary.
Maya: will follow up with reconcile results in ~45m.
Sofia: noting backlog item MET-3422 for deterministic route-hash in events.
Maya: thanks all :pray:
